title: Kagamine Rin — Unheard Voice〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Rin made sure to watch over me.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Then, I'm gonna head back to SEKAI...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Have you had a chance to rest at all?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. The others have been coming over in shifts, but you've been here for two whole days.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<I'm fine.
It's not like I have anything else to do. Plus, I've been resting over there.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<You don't have to worry about me.
Anyway, I'm heading back...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (I'm glad that Kanade's feeling better now.)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
(But I still want her to rest some more...
I should go over again tomorrow to make sure she does.)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (I also need to rest to make sure she doesn't worry about me...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
(I feel hot all of a sudden...
And my body feels really heavy for some reason...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
(Wait a second...
Mafuyu said she felt the same way when she caught that cold...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (But we can't catch colds, can we?)
Yes, why don't you put it on her?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
S-Sorry, I didn't mean to wake you...
I was just trying to put this blanket on you.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
That's fine...
I was wondering why my body felt hot and heavy all of a sudden.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I can imagine so...
Why don't you take those off now?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Blankets and towels too.
What are all these doing on me?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You were covered in them by the time I arrived.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Because a certain someone haphazardly asked Miku and Len to bring over anything they could.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Well, she was sleeping all curled up on the ground.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I thought she could use something, too. So I wrapped the scarf Mafuyu and the others gave me around her...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I also found a lot of covers for her...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: By the way, KAITO's the one who told us about you, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, KAITO, you came over to talk to me of your own volition? Should I keep an eye out for flying pigs?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Rin's on the ground over there.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I didn't fall over or anything. I was just resting.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, Miku, you can have your gloves and scarf back now.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Thanks for letting me use them.
I know they mean a lot to you...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
You can keep sleeping, Rin.
We'll put away any blankets and such you don't need.
